---
title: "Global Wine Market Investment & Sourcing Strategy"
author: Melody Wu
date: 2025-05-01
categories: [Tableau, Data Visualization]
---

Built an interactive Tableau dashboard analyzing 130,000+ wine reviews 
and macroeconomic data to guide sourcing and investment decisions for 
wine distributors. Identified pricing arbitrage opportunities across 
global markets through integrated analysis of quality ratings, 
production volumes, and GDP indicators.
